affected_subject.reason: Identifies getBestBidPrice/getBestAskPrice in Book.sol and _executeBidLimitOrder in CLOB.sol as affected functions.

trigger_or_action.reason: Attacker places a small soon-to-expire order at top of book; after expiration it remains in price tree and blocks new post-only orders.

direct_effect.reason: Post-only orders are rejected with PostOnlyOrderWouldFill due to expired order, causing denial-of-service on post-only orders.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Establishes expected-vs-actual mismatch: price check ignores expiration while matching skips expired orders, so rejection is inconsistent with actual matchability.

summary: Report identifies affected functions, attacker trigger via expiring top-of-book order, concrete rejection effect on post-only orders, and a clear inconsistency between price-check and matching expiration handling.
